onscreen_lines.desc: Percent Markup MARKUP LINE In the case of line items awarded on the basis of markup from Offeror, an informal (telephone or written) price quote may be requested, for items contained within the general line item category. The District may purchase the best value item using any contracts made pursuant to an award under this solicitation, whether in a form of a signed written agreement, a purchase order, these ST&Cs, or otherwise (each, a "Contract") with the awarded Offeror who enters into the Contract (each, a "Vendor") as the basis for that purchase. Offeror quote, if applicable, and invoice will reflect the original price, the percent markup, and the final cost to the District. For example original cost multiply by markup percent, original cost plus markup equals price charged to the District. $100.00 X 10% = $10.00. $100.00 + $10.00 = $110.00. Line items left blank will be considered zero (0) percent. Entering zero (0) percent in the markup lines means that the product will be sold to the District at cost. A percent markup is the % difference between the cost of a good or service and what you can sell it for.
